cards.title: The week the index went up and most companies didn't
cards.why: Nasdaq +2.06% against the Russell 2000's -0.80% over the same five days is a breadth gap a family investor can see in one chart, and it lands on a weekend with markets shut.

cards.title: Everyone reported a bond selloff; the Treasury's own figures show the short end easing
cards.why: Fully primary on treasury.gov: the 2-year fell 6bp and the 10-year 1bp while only the 30-year rose, against two days of vendor headlines calling the 10-year the highest since the financial crisis.
